title: Sufficient Dimension Reduction with Multimodal Predictor Objects
abstract: arXiv:2611.13460v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the regression of a scalar response $Y$ on a Euclidean predictor $\mathbf{X} \in \mathbb{R}^p$ and a random predictor object $\mathcal{Z}$ in a general metric space under arbitrary structural dependence. We introduce a joint sufficient dimension reduction $(\mathbf{B}^\top\mathbf{X}, \mathcal{G}_Z)$ constructed via a sequential conditional independence framework, which differs fundamentally from the ordinary central subspace of $Y \mid \mathbf{X}$. Methodologically, $\mathcal{Z}$ is embedded into a reproducing kernel Hilbert space, and a regularized kernel-response envelope model extracts a finite-dimensional reduction of the feature map. Partial adaptive estimation then recovers the Euclidean reduction conditional on the first-stage coordinates. We establish root-$n$ consistency rates for the first-stage envelope subspace under a shrinking regularizer, alongside large-sample consistency for the second-stage Euclidean subspace

translated_title: 基于多模态预测对象的充分降维
translated_abstract: 我们研究了标量响应变量 $Y$ 对欧氏预测变量 $\mathbf{X} \in \mathbb{R}^p$ 以及处于一般度量空间中的随机预测对象 $\mathcal{Z}$ 在任意结构依赖下的回归问题。我们通过序贯条件独立性框架引入了联合充分降维 $(\mathbf{B}^\top\mathbf{X}, \mathcal{G}_Z)$，这与 $Y \mid \mathbf{X}$ 的普通中心子空间存在本质区别。在方法论上，$\mathcal{Z}$ 被嵌入到再生核希尔伯特空间中，并通过正则化核-响应包络模型提取特征映射的有限维降维。随后，部分自适应估计在给定第一阶段坐标的条件下恢复欧氏降维。我们建立了在收缩正则化参数下第一阶段包络子空间的 root-$n$ 收敛速度，以及第二阶段欧氏子空间的大样本一致性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种针对欧氏预测变量与一般度量空间中随机预测对象的联合充分降维新框架，通过序贯条件独立性、核嵌入与正则化包络模型实现两阶段降维，并建立了第一阶段子空间 root-$n$ 收敛速度与第二阶段子空间大样本一致性的理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a joint sufficient dimension reduction framework for a Euclidean predictor and a random object in a general metric space, embedding the object into a reproducing kernel Hilbert space with a regularized kernel-response envelope model, and establishes root-$n$ consistency and large-sample consistency for the two-stage reductions.
